ambiguity.detail: The clip opens with a flash-forward line from an unseen villain before jumping back to the main wedding confrontation.

verdict.hook_line: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: You knew this before I walked through those doors!
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A young woman walks down the aisle believing she is the bride, only to find her fiancé hand-in-hand with another woman.
verdict.why_it_works: Starting with a venomous insult hook grabs scrollers instantly, and the slow reveal of the wedding betrayal builds gripping drama.
